upstream.extraction: HTMLParser with convert_charrefs=True; concatenate text inside the first pre element, retaining whitespace

methodology.compile: Fresh serial source-to-executable builds, including MLF LLVM emission, IR writes, runtime C compilation and linking. Tool/compiler/harness setup excluded. Fresh output directory per sample; no object cache. Rotating language order.
methodology.runtime: All binaries built and checked before any timed samples; exact runtime input checked once before timing as warmup. Process startup/IO/GC/exit included. Output checked again after each sample, outside timing. No time subtraction.
methodology.resource_measurement: wait4 child usage: user+system CPU; Darwin RSS bytes, Linux RSS KiB converted to bytes. Pipeline CPU summed, RSS maximum over stages.
methodology.normalization: Wall medians divided by C wall median; ratio below 1 is allowed.

input_integrity: All recorded source, manifest, harness, compiler and runtime hashes unchanged
